start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep my notes as long as my keep rule says", with rule set to the id of your keep-rule row, and store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"}. Then declare a wake of yours on this workflow with the schedule you want.
no_lists_because: It names no list: the keep rule and the records are the person's own rows, in whatever form their store keeps them.
instructions: 1. Make a keep rule row in your store: enabled, the kind it keeps, its expiry rule, page and walk.
2. Declare a wake of yours on workflow:keep-records-as-long-as-their-keep-rule-says with the input {"rule": "<the rule's row id>"} and the schedule you want; it stays off until you switch it on.
3. Edit the rule to change what is kept; the next firing reads it again. Turn enabled off to stop it.
4. A record removed stays restorable until its undo window ends.
